breakdown.description: The setup uses C3D8 elements, but the deck uses C3D20R elements.
breakdown.reason: The agent was supposed to resolve the conflict between the instruction to use C3D8 elements and the provided input deck which uses C3D20R elements. The ground truth resolves this by using the provided input deck verbatim. The agent failed to do this; it discarded the entire provided input deck and generated a completely new, incorrect one. While the new deck happens to use C3D20R elements, the failure to use the authoritative model from the prompt means the inconsistency was not resolved correctly.

breakdown.description: The setup assumes that the body force is gravity, but the deck applies a centrifugal load.
breakdown.reason: The agent was supposed to resolve the conflict between the instruction to assume gravity as the body force and the provided input deck which uses a centrifugal load. The ground truth resolves this by using the provided input deck exactly as written. The agent failed this core task by generating a completely different input deck. Although the new deck also applies a centrifugal load, the agent's failure to use the provided model means it did not resolve the inconsistency as required.
